features.title: Features

features.locked: Comes with your plan; cannot be changed here.

non_physical.label: Digital and service products
non_physical.description: Sell products that need no shipping (e-books, gift codes, courses, services); they ask for no shipping or measurements.

indexnow.label: Announce changed pages with IndexNow
indexnow.description: When a product, category or brand page is added, changed or removed, Bing, Yandex and other IndexNow search engines are told. Needs the shop's main domain; Google does not take part.

publish_gate.label: SEO publish gate
publish_gate.description: A product with a critical gap (no price or image) or an SEO score under 50 cannot go live. When off, the advisor only suggests.

preorder.label: Selling past stock (preorder)
preorder.description: A variant whose stock runs out can still be sold, as a preorder or shipped from a supplier. Turned on per variant on the product page; search engines are told it is on backorder.

gift_cards.label: Gift cards and store credit
gift_cards.description: Gift cards can be made and given to customers, who use the code in their basket and keep what is left for later. Store credit takes refunds or goodwill amounts onto an account.

cash_on_delivery.label: Cash on delivery
cash_on_delivery.description: Shoppers can pay the courier on delivery. The fee, the limit and the couriers that collect are under Settings > Payment > Cash on delivery.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Long tasks such as exports. Files are kept for a week.
jobs.empty: No jobs yet. They show up here when you start an export.

audit.subtitle: Who changed what, and who looked at personal data. Opening this page is recorded too.
audit.exportStarted: Export started. Download the file from Jobs when it is ready.
audit.retention: Exported files are kept on the Jobs page for a week.

locations.title: Locations

locations.noAddress: No address yet; shipping and returns will need one.

other.description: Ways besides cards you can offer your customers.

iyzico.name: iyzico
iyzico.description: Credit and debit cards, in one payment or in installments.

bank_transfer.name: Bank transfer
bank_transfer.description: The customer sends the amount to your bank account; you confirm the order once it arrives.

cash_on_delivery.name: Cash on delivery
cash_on_delivery.description: The customer pays on delivery; you can add a fee and an amount limit.

account.keyMissing: The server has no encryption key for payment details, so they cannot be saved. Tell the platform team.

account.title: Store details

notification.title: Notification address
notification.description: PayTR sends payment results to this address; only then are orders confirmed.

live.title: Test mode and going live
live.description: Try a payment before you open your shop; PayTR approves going live.

paytr.merchantIdHint: The store number PayTR gave you; digits only.

paytr.testModeHint: While on, no real money is taken; you try payments with PayTR's test cards.

address.copyFailed: Could not copy; select the address and copy it yourself.

iyzico.testModeHint: While on, no real money is taken. Sandbox and live keys differ; enter both again when you switch.

iyzico.rejected: iyzico no longer accepts the stored keys; no payment can be taken. Copy both keys from the iyzico panel and enter them again.

account.title: Account

advisor.title: SEO advisor
advisor.cardHint: How ready the page is for search engines; assessed again after every save.
advisor.why: Why it matters, how to fix it

TITLE-01.title: The search result title is {{length}} characters; {{min}}–{{max}} is advised.
TITLE-01.why: A short title says little about the page; a long one is cut in search results. Turkish letters are wide, so the pixel width counts too.
TITLE-01.how: Edit the SEO title, or remove your own title to use the shop's title template.

TITLE-02.title: {{count}} more pages share this title.
TITLE-02.why: Pages with the same title compete in search; which one shows becomes unclear.
TITLE-02.how: Add a property that sets the page apart (colour, size, material).

TITLE-03.title: The title has {{problem}}.
TITLE-03.why: Shouting, repeated or symbol-heavy titles look untrustworthy and search engines may rewrite them.
TITLE-03.how: Write the title plainly, in normal case.

TITLE-04.title: The brand ({{brand}}) is not in the title.
TITLE-04.why: Shoppers searching for a brand click more on results that show it.
TITLE-04.how: Add the {marka} token to the title template or the brand to the SEO title.

META-01.title: The meta description is {{length}} characters; {{min}}–{{max}} is advised.
META-01.why: The description shows under the title in results; when short the search engine picks any text from the page, when long it is cut.
META-01.how: Write a description with the benefit and a price or shipping hint, or use the template.

META-02.title: {{count}} more pages share this description.
META-02.why: The same description makes pages hard to tell apart in results.
META-02.how: Make the description this page's own.

SLUG-01.title: The page address ({{slug}}) breaks the rules.
SLUG-01.why: Addresses use lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, up to 80 characters; otherwise they look broken when shared and searched.
SLUG-01.how: Make the address again from the name.

SLUG-02.title: The page address ({{slug}}) has none of the name's words.
SLUG-02.why: Meaningful words in the address tell shoppers and search engines what the page is.
SLUG-02.how: Make the address from the product's or page's name; the old one redirects on its own.

KW-01.title: The focus keyword "{{keyword}}" is missing from: {{missing}}.
KW-01.why: When the chosen word is in the title, the description and the start of the text, the page matches that search better.
KW-01.how: Add the word where it is missing, in a natural sentence.

ROBOTS-01.title: The page is closed to search engines (noindex).
ROBOTS-01.why: This page does not show in search; the other suggestions still help sharing and quality.
ROBOTS-01.how: If that is not intended, set the index choice in the SEO card to "by the page's state".

CONT-01.title: The text has {{words}} words; at least {{min}} is advised.
CONT-01.why: A short text does not answer shoppers' questions nor tell search engines enough about the page.
CONT-01.how: Add sections such as features, use, care and specifications.

CONT-03.title: Required attributes are empty: {{fields}}.
CONT-03.why: The attribute table informs comparing shoppers and filters; empty fields drop the product from lists.
CONT-03.how: Fill the missing fields in the attributes card.

CONT-04.title: The description has a main heading (H1).
CONT-04.why: The page's H1 is the product's name; a second one in the text blurs the page's subject.
CONT-04.how: Make the text's headings subheadings (H2, H3).

CONT-07.title: The description has an insecure (http) link or image.
CONT-07.why: http content on a secure page triggers browser warnings or does not load at all.
CONT-07.how: Change the links to start with https.

IMG-01.title: {{count}} images; at least {{target}} are advised.
IMG-01.why: Products without images do not show in Google Shopping nor in rich results; several angles build trust.
IMG-01.how: Add images showing the product from different angles.

DATA-01.title: {{count}} variants have no price.
DATA-01.why: A product without a price cannot be sold nor offered to search engines.
DATA-01.how: Enter each variant's price in the variants card.

DATA-02.title: {{count}} variants have no barcode (GTIN) nor brand + manufacturer code (MPN).
DATA-02.why: Google Shopping recognises products by these codes; without them the product matches less and shows less.
DATA-02.how: Enter a valid barcode for the variants; without one, add the brand and the manufacturer code.

DATA-03.title: The product has no brand.
DATA-03.why: The brand is what shoppers look for in structured data and results.
DATA-03.how: Pick a brand in the organise card.

DATA-04.title: No primary category is chosen.
DATA-04.why: The primary category sets the product's breadcrumb and its "back to category" link.
DATA-04.how: Make the deepest category primary in one click, or pick one in the catalog card.

DATA-05.title: Weight or dimensions are missing.
DATA-05.why: Shipping costs and delivery details are worked out from them.
DATA-05.how: Enter the weight and dimensions in the package card.

LINK-01.title: The product is in no category.
LINK-01.why: No link inside the shop leads to it; shoppers and search engines find it hard.
LINK-01.how: Pick at least one category in the organise card.

EMPTY-01.title: The page lists no live products.
EMPTY-01.why: An empty list disappoints visitors and search engines count it as thin content.
EMPTY-01.how: Add products, or close the page to search engines.

DEPTH-01.title: The category is at level {{depth}}; {{max}} at most is advised.
DEPTH-01.why: Deep structures sit far from the home page and are crawled less.

LOGO-01.title: The brand has no logo.
LOGO-01.why: A logo makes the brand recognisable on its page and when shared.
LOGO-01.how: Upload an image in the logo card.

IMG-02.why: Alt text tells people who cannot see an image, and image search, what it shows; without it the image does not appear in image search.
IMG-02.how: In the Images section, write a short description for each image: the product, its colour, the angle.

LEN-01.title: The text has {{words}} words; at least {{min}} is recommended.
LEN-01.why: Short pages do not answer the question fully; search engines and AI answers favour thorough content.
LEN-01.how: Expand the topic with examples, steps or frequently asked questions.

STRUCT-01.title: Weak structure: {{problem}}.
STRUCT-01.why: Question-style subheadings and paragraphs of 2–4 sentences read easily; search engines and AI answers quote sections one by one.
STRUCT-01.how: Split the text with question-style H2/H3 headings, break long paragraphs; use a list or table where it fits.

ANSWER-01.title: The opening has {{words}} words; a {{min}}–{{max}} word answer block is recommended.
ANSWER-01.why: A short section that answers the question on its own before the first heading is more likely to be quoted in AI answers and featured results.
ANSWER-01.how: Start the post with a {{min}}–{{max}} word introduction that sums up the topic.

INLINK-01.title: {{links}} internal links; at least {{min}} is recommended at this length.
INLINK-01.why: Links to products and categories take the reader to shopping and help search engines discover your pages.
INLINK-01.how: Link the products and categories the text mentions, or add their cards.

BYLINE-01.title: The post's author is not named.
BYLINE-01.why: An author name builds trust; search engines want to see who wrote the post.
BYLINE-01.how: Enter the author in the General card.

COVER-01.title: Images: {{problem}}.
COVER-01.why: Images support the text and are found in image search; alt text describes them to screen readers and search engines.
COVER-01.how: Add a cover image and write what each image shows in its alt text.

STALE-01.title: The text has not been updated for {{days}} days.
STALE-01.why: Content kept up to date looks more trustworthy to readers and search engines.
STALE-01.how: Review the facts; update products, prices and dates.

TEXT-01.title: The page's text is {{words}} words; at least {{min}} is suggested.
TEXT-01.why: A filter page earns its place by what it adds to the product list; a short text makes it a copy of the list.
TEXT-01.how: Add buying advice, comparisons and common questions specific to this category and filter.

UNIQ-01.title: Only {{originality}}% of the text is this page's own; at least {{min}}% is recommended.
UNIQ-01.why: Programmatic pages that resemble each other fall under Google's scaled content policy; a page must be valuable on its own.
UNIQ-01.how: Write facts, comparisons and advice specific to this category and filter; do not repeat other pages' text.

PRODUCTS-01.title: The page lists {{products}} products; at least {{min}} is recommended.
PRODUCTS-01.why: A filter page with very few products offers little choice and counts as thin content.
PRODUCTS-01.how: Add products that match this filter, or keep the page out of search.

BATCH-01.title: {{count}} filter pages went live in the last {{days}} days; at most {{max}} is recommended.
BATCH-01.why: Publishing many programmatic pages at once looks like spam to search engines.
BATCH-01.how: Publish pages in batches of 50–100, two weeks apart.

REVIEW-01.title: Only {{share}}% of the latest batch was reviewed by a person; at least {{min}}% is recommended.
REVIEW-01.why: Human review catches mistakes and repetition in programmatic pages.
REVIEW-01.how: Read the page and mark it "Reviewed by a person".

S-HOST-01.title: The store is not ready for search engines
S-HOST-01.why: Without a primary domain, pages have no canonical address and there is no sitemap; an environment closed to search engines is never indexed.

S-ROBOTS-01.title: robots.txt blocks search engines
S-ROBOTS-01.why: One rule in robots.txt can drop every product or category page from search results. The Sitemap line shows crawlers where the list of pages is.

S-SITEMAP-01.title: The sitemap is out of date
S-SITEMAP-01.why: Search engines learn about new and changed pages from the sitemap first; an old or partial one means new products show up late.

S-404-01.why: Addresses visitors and search engines asked for many times, this week too, but cannot find cost sales and rankings. A 301 to the suggested page carries the address's value over.

S-DUP-01.title_one: {{amount}} title or description is the same on several pages
S-DUP-01.title_other: {{amount}} titles or descriptions are the same on several pages
S-DUP-01.why: Pages showing the same title compete with each other in search results and tell searchers nothing apart. Titles from the template count too: give pages a distinct name or their own title.

S-ORPHAN-01.title_one: {{amount}} live product is in no category
S-ORPHAN-01.title_other: {{amount}} live products are in no category
S-ORPHAN-01.why: Nothing in the store links to a product without a category; search engines find it late and rate it low. Add it to at least one category.

S-REDIR-01.why: A rule whose target is missing or removed sends visitors to an empty page; a rule under a live page never runs; a rule whose target redirects again is out of date. Rules unused for a year can go; records with many old addresses carry a redirect for each.

S-IMG-01.title_one: {{amount}} product image has no alt text
S-IMG-01.title_other: {{amount}} product images have no alt text
S-IMG-01.why: An image without alt text is blank to image search and screen readers. Add it in the product page's Images section.

S-HOST-01.no_host: No primary domain: no canonical addresses and no sitemap.
S-HOST-01.indexing_off: This environment is closed to search engines (SEO_INDEXING); robots.txt blocks every crawler.
S-HOST-01.staging_indexed: This is a staging environment but it is open to search engines (SEO_INDEXING); its copy competes with the live store.

S-ROBOTS-01.no_sitemap: robots.txt does not give the sitemap's address.
S-ROBOTS-01.facets_open: A filtered or sorted listing is open to crawlers; their budget goes on thousands of combinations. Add the {facet_disallow} line to the robots.txt template.

S-SITEMAP-01.stale: The sitemap has not been refreshed in over two days.
S-SITEMAP-01.never: The sitemap has never been built.
S-SITEMAP-01.missing_one: {{amount}} page is missing from the sitemap.
S-SITEMAP-01.missing_other: {{amount}} pages are missing from the sitemap.
S-SITEMAP-01.no_path_one: {{amount}} live page has no address; it cannot appear in the sitemap or the store.
S-SITEMAP-01.no_path_other: {{amount}} live pages have no address; they cannot appear in the sitemap or the store.

S-404-01.missing_other: {{amount}} requests in all; asked for this week too

S-REDIR-01.idle_other: Unused for a year; {{amount}} hits in all
S-REDIR-01.shadowed: A live page has this address; the rule never runs.
